note: jpRelease is the original Japanese release date, taken only from Bandai official product pages; sets whose official page is no longer up are left without it rather than guessed. The release date shown at the top of each set page is the ENGLISH edition date and is a different thing.

reprintAudit.source: https://www.onepiece-cardgame.com/news/ and per-set official product pages
reprintAudit.rule: A lottery sale only counts as extra supply if its entry period falls AFTER the Japanese release date. Bandai runs Premium Bandai lotteries for the initial print run too (OP-17: entries 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-07~18, release 2026-08-22), and those are advance allocation, not a restock.
reprintAudit.coverage: Bandai JP news feed read back to 2026-06-06 only. Official product pages exist for OP-13 and OP-17; OP-01~OP-12 and OP-14~OP-16 return 404, so their Japanese release dates are still unverified and any lottery found for them cannot yet be classified.
